title: Pacific Utility
creator: Michael Hoydich
status: Independent speculative design study; no products for sale

products.name: Harbor Base
products.copy: A carry-anywhere energy base. One handle, a readable gauge, and power for the whole little fleet.
products.description: The anchor of the collection: a low, wide power station with replaceable corner guards, covered ports and a proper carry handle. Live on the sand for an afternoon, then dock under the console at home.
specs: Protected DC outputs, solar input with MPPT, USB-C
Serviceable LiFePO₄ module, subject to engineering
Physical power switch, rotary dial, energy display
addons: Clip-on cable tidy and labeled connector caps
Sailcloth shoulder sling and raised sand feet
products.validation: Validate battery safety, thermal management, output limits, grounding where applicable and safe service access. The 90% usable-energy factor in the planner is an illustration.

products.name: Sunboard
products.copy: A folding solar panel that earns its place. A charging surface, a stand, and the bones of a useful table.
products.description: Four framed panels fold into a flat carrying case. A locking support sets their sun angle; an optional separate tray makes a small table when charging is not the priority. A rail-mount study brings it home.
specs: Four folding segments with guarded hinges
Kickstand, privacy screen, removable table tray
Matched MPPT input at Harbor Base
addons: Removable tray that never bears directly on solar cells
Angle card and padded cable roll
products.validation: Test structural loads, panel temperatures, cell protection, stability and wind anchoring. Shading a panel reduces generation. Balcony mounts require a site-specific safe installation.

products.name: Cold Box
products.copy: A small compressor refrigerator with a big useful lid. Cold drinks, simple controls, and a place for everything.
products.description: An insulated portable refrigerator with a replaceable gasket, removable divider and easy-to-read temperature display. Its power plan starts with pre-chilling at home and giving the compressor priority at camp.
specs: 25 W averaged over compressor cycles for illustration
Insulated shell, replaceable seal, guarded corners
Local thermostat and low-battery cutoff concept
products.validation: Validate actual temperature holding, ambient operating limits, average draw and ventilation clearances. No runtime or food-storage safety performance has been established.

products.name: Dock Fan
products.copy: The fan that goes where you sit. A pivoting head, a steady stance, and a pleasantly obvious dial.
products.description: A compact air circulator with a folding yoke, removable grille and replaceable small battery pack. Stand it on a table, secure it with an approved clamp, or aim it through a tent opening.
specs: 12 W average in the illustrative planner
Physical speed dial; Bluetooth pairing concept
Serviceable motor assembly and washable grille
Removable pack or protected base connection
addons: Clamp mount and low, wide sand stand
Passive wind scoop for an independent airflow study
products.validation: Measure airflow, acoustic output, stability, finger access protection, battery runtime and salt exposure. The wind scoop channels ambient air; it does not make electricity or refrigerate the air.

products.name: Buoy Light
products.copy: From the picnic blanket to the bedside. A friendly pool of light with a grab handle and a real dimmer.
products.description: A warm-white portable lantern with a protected diffuser, replaceable small pack and tactile dimmer. An optional shade keeps the light on the table and out of your eyes.
specs: 4 W average in the illustrative planner
products.validation: Validate light quality, thermal behavior, charging safety, hanging strength and water/dust protection before making ratings or runtime claims.

products.name: Room Current
products.copy: A proper home fan. A quiet-looking pedestal, a removable desk head, and a battery tucked neatly in the base.
products.description: The domestic member of the fleet: a convertible pedestal-to-table circulator. The weighted base holds a removable pack; a future home bridge could coordinate it with light and open-window routines.
specs: Local dial, optional Bluetooth and future home bridge
Removable grille, replaceable motor and base module
Proposed scenes with explicit owner approval
addons: Short desk stem and wall cradle
Optional temperature sensor for future scene logic
products.validation: Validate tip stability, noise, oscillation safety, power consumption and every wireless integration. No live Bluetooth, Matter or AI connection is provided in this preview.

ivrea.name: Ivrea Office
ivrea.copy: Office-machine clarity, brought outdoors. Putty shells, Adriatic-blue faces, precise type and a single vermilion button. Every seam explains how the object comes apart.

skerry.name: Swedish Skerry
skerry.copy: Mist blue, chalk and pale ash. A quieter expression of the same equipment, with linen carrying loops and small wood touch points. A summer-house atmosphere that still takes service seriously.

vienna.name: Vienna Workshop
vienna.copy: Midnight navy and parchment with brushed-brass details. Repeated square perforations give the lamp and fan a shared rhythm. Useful domestic instruments with a little ceremonial presence.
